profile.constituencyprofile_Text: Ramachandrapuram Constituency is located in Dr. B. R. Ambedkar Konaseema District and comprises three mandals —Ramachandrapuram, K. Gangavaram, and Kajuluru — along with Ramachandrapuram Municipality. Ramachandrapuram Town serves as the Constituency Headquarters. Historically, the region was known as “Penkullapadu” and was ruled by the Raja Kakarlapudi Dynasty, whose seat of power was at Kotipalli Kota. During the mid-17th Century, severe floods led to the destruction of their Fort and several Temples at Kotipalli. Following this devastation, the rulers constructed a new Fort at Ramachandrapuram, near the present old bus stand. Subsequently, the dynasty installed their clan deities, Sri Rukmini Satyabhama Sameta Venu Gopal Swamy, at Pedapati Vari Veedhi (22nd Ward) near the present Annapurna Theatre, where a temple was later constructed. In honor of the Kakarlapudi rulers, the land was renamed Ramachandrapuram, a name by which it continues to be known today.
profile.geography:
Ramachandrapuram Constituency is located in Dr. B. R. Ambedkar Konaseema District of Andhra Pradesh. The Constituency covers a Geographical Area of 350.47 Square Kilometers. The Constituency boundaries are as follows: Ramachandrapuram Mandal forms the core of the Constituency. 

·        It is bounded by Ainavilli and Mummidivaram Mandals to the South. 

·        Tallarevu Mandal lies to the East. 

·        Rayavaram Mandal lies to the West.

·      Kapileswarapuram Mandal and Karapa Mandal lie to the North.
profile.populationDesc: As per the 2011 Census, Ramachandrapuram Constituency has a total population of 2,48,443. Out of this, 1,25,070 are Males and 1,23,373 are Females. The Sex ratio of the Constituency stands at 982 Females per 1,000 Males, indicating a relatively balanced gender composition.
profile.administrationDesc: Ramachandrapuram Constituency is one of the Assembly Constituencies in Dr. B. R. Ambedkar Konaseema District. The Constituency comprises four Administrative Units, namely Ramachandrapuram Rural, Ramachandrapuram Urban, K. Gangavaram, and Kajuluru Mandals.

economy_text.economy_Text:
Ramachandrapuram’s Economy at a Glance


The Economic Vision Plan for constituency lays a structured path for accelerating economic growth, boosting employment, and ensuring inclusive development. With a Gross Constituency Domestic Product (GCDP) of ₹4527 crores in 2023-24, Ramachandrapuram is projected to expand steadily, reaching ₹9643 crores by 2028-29, marking a significant transformation across agriculture, industry, and services sectors.
The industrial sector accounts for 13.56%, agriculture and allied activities contribute 42.71% and service sector contributes 43.73%.
economy_text.gcdP_Growth_Text: Ramachandrapuram is witnessing steady economic momentum with a targeted 15% annual GCDP growth rate across key sectors like Real estate Ownership of Dwellings, Fishing & Aquaculture, agriculture and livestock. This growth trajectory aligns with the long-term vision of making the constituency a vibrant urban and economic hub by 2047.
